html: The three preceding subsections decomposed BG learning into analytically separable components (loss functions, error signals, plasticity). This section reassembles them into a unified picture. Aim: trace the full transduction chain from action selection through dopaminergic evaluation to durable corticostriatal weight change, showing that BG loss, error, and plasticity are three views onto one continuously running policy-optimization process. Caveat about speculative stitching where normative frameworks outrun circuit-level evidence.
